figures.name: The Dagda

ability.name: Cauldron of Plenty
ability.description: Fully restore one ally's HP; give all allies +1 to all stats.

figures.description: Father-god of the Tuatha Dé Danann who wields a club that kills and a cauldron that never empties.

figures.name: The Morrigan

ability.name: Crow's Prophecy
ability.description: Choose one enemy; that card is marked for death and takes +3 damage from all sources for 2 turns.

figures.description: Triple war goddess of fate who appears as a crow on the battlefield and decides who lives and dies.

figures.name: Lugh

ability.name: Spear of Lugh
ability.description: Throw a never-missing spear dealing 7 damage; enemy cannot dodge or shield.

figures.description: Master of every skill and craft, solar champion of the Tuatha Dé Danann who slew his own grandfather Balor.

figures.name: Cú Chulainn

ability.name: Riastrad (Warp-Spasm)
ability.description: Transform: gain +4 power and +3 speed but lose 3 defense for 2 turns.

figures.description: Greatest Irish warrior hero who enters an unstoppable berserker warp-spasm in the heat of battle.

figures.name: Manannán mac Lir

ability.name: Cloak of Mists
ability.description: Make all allies untargetable for 1 turn; swap one ally with a copy of an enemy.

figures.description: Lord of the sea and guardian of the Otherworld who rides his horse over the waves and controls fate.

figures.name: Brigid

ability.name: Sacred Flame
ability.description: Heal all allies for 3 HP; grant the weakest ally +3 magic for 2 turns.

figures.description: Triple goddess of fire, poetry and healing whose sacred flame at Kildare burned for centuries.

figures.name: Nuada Airgetlám

ability.name: Silver Hand
ability.description: Restore a disabled ability to any ally; deal 4 damage to one enemy.

figures.description: First high king of the Tuatha Dé Danann who received a perfect silver arm after losing his own in battle.

figures.name: Balor

ability.name: Evil Eye
ability.description: Open: deal 8 damage to one target regardless of defense or shields.

figures.description: King of the demonic Fomorians whose single enormous eye kills everything it gazes upon when opened.

figures.name: Fionn mac Cumhaill

ability.name: Thumb of Knowledge
ability.description: Gain full knowledge of all enemy abilities and stats for the rest of the battle.

figures.description: Leader of the Fianna warriors who gained all wisdom by accidentally tasting the Salmon of Knowledge.

figures.name: Cernunnos

ability.name: Lord of Beasts
ability.description: Summon one beast ally with stats matching the highest-powered enemy for 2 turns.

figures.description: Antlered god of wild animals and fertility, seated among beasts, master of the cycle of nature.

figures.name: Danu

ability.name: Rivers of Life
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies each turn for 3 turns.

figures.description: Ancient mother goddess from whom the divine Tuatha Dé Danann take their name.

figures.name: Donn

ability.name: House of Donn
ability.description: All enemies lose 1 HP per turn for 3 turns as darkness creeps in.

figures.description: Lord of the dead who dwells on a rocky island off the southwest coast of Ireland awaiting the souls of the deceased.

figures.name: Medb

ability.name: Sovereignty's Price
ability.description: Choose one enemy: force it to lose 2 power or 2 defense, your choice.

figures.description: Warrior queen of Connacht whose insatiable appetites for war and men drove the great Ulster Cycle.

figures.name: Diarmuid Ua Duibhne

ability.name: Love Spot
ability.description: Force one enemy to protect this card for 1 turn instead of attacking.

figures.description: Irresistible warrior of the Fianna whose magical love spot made any woman who saw him fall helplessly in love.

figures.name: Midir

ability.name: Fairy Chess
ability.description: Win: negate the next special ability played against your side.

figures.description: Beautiful king of the fairy mound Brí Léith who reclaimed his love Étaín across multiple reincarnations.

figures.name: Oisín

ability.name: Song of Tír na nÓg
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies and remove one debuff from each.

figures.description: Son of Fionn who spent 300 years in the eternal youth of the Otherworld with the goddess Niamh.

figures.name: Selkie

ability.name: Seal Skin
ability.description: Steal one enemy buff and seal it; enemy cannot reactivate that buff this battle.

figures.description: Seal people who shed their skins on land, irresistibly drawn between sea and human love.

figures.name: Puca

ability.name: Wild Ride
ability.description: Randomly redistribute all stat bonuses on the field between all cards.

figures.description: Shape-shifting trickster spirit that takes the form of a dark horse, goat or hare to mislead travelers.

figures.name: Banshee

ability.name: Keening Wail
ability.description: The next ally or enemy to fall this battle deals 3 damage to all when they do.

figures.description: Wailing spirit whose cry announces an imminent death in the great Irish families descended from the Milesians.

figures.name: Áine

ability.name: Midsummer Blessing
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 magic and immunity to dark-alignment effects for 1 turn.

figures.description: Sun and fairy queen of Munster who governs love, summer and the blossoming of crops.
